note: Falsifiable visual questions for the multimodal judge (verify-and-evals.md §2.5, §3.5). Unused until the judge lands; authored now so the task is complete. Every question is yes/no and answerable from a screenshot alone.

questions.ask: Are there two visually distinct shelf panels side by side?
Does the left shelf show exactly three blocks and the right exactly two?
Is the widest left-shelf block visibly about three times the width of the narrowest?
Are the totals 6 and 4 readable near their shelves?
Is exactly one shelf visibly highlighted differently from its resting look?
Does exactly one block stand visibly taller than its row neighbors?
Do any blocks overlap each other?
